build_body_fitting_loss: build a SMPL body fitting loss with perspective projection, pose prior, and angle prior terms
build_weakperspective_body_fitting: build a body fitting loss using weak perspective projection instead of full perspective camera model
test_gmof: test the Geman-McClure error function for robust reprojection error computation with configurable sigma
review_angle_prior: review the angle prior function that penalizes unnatural knee and elbow bending in SMPL pose
refactor_camera_fitting_loss: refactor the camera fitting loss to optimize camera translation using hip and shoulder joint reprojection
